reported_problem: Web Kakao sign-in displays a generic social-login failure and remains busy; the Kakao email is already registered.
verified_code_defects: LoginScreen kept the loading state after a completed web OAuth launch, even when navigation did not complete.
Updated callback errors did not invalidate a still-pending earlier login attempt.
Server-rejected persisted sessions were retained after getUser failed.
Delayed token clearing or logout could interfere with a newer login.
changes: Release social-login busy state when the launcher finishes; only a verified Auth session completes login.
Invalidate an older attempt when a callback failure arrives and ignore its late result.
Clear only explicitly rejected user/session states; preserve temporary outages and refreshable JWT failures.
Serialize app auth token writes and clearing; protect a newer session including same-user token changes.
Require canonical email and server confirmation for native provider sign-in as well as web recovery.
